inputs.objectiveNote: Find the greatest practical number of valid, saleable lots within the fixed boundary, Compact/Family mix, permitted South Main Road access and protected features. Best found among tested options.
inputs.source: Fictitious owner test brief. Rectangle coordinates supplied in metres; no survey, title or authority verification. South Main Road 12 m full width supplied, no carriageway or access approval.
inputs.fixedRequirements: 120 × 100 m boundary; 12,000 m² gross; protected feature and buffer fixed; products Compact 6 × 12 m, Family 8 × 16 m; valid-count target60/40 ±5pp mandatory. No boundary stretch or protection movement.
inputs.preferences: Coherent street sections; same products facing across double-loaded roads; right-angle intersections preferred, oblique allowed where valid.
inputs.adjustable: Permitted entrance location, unlocked internal road alignments and groups, flexible open-space vertices above commitments.
inputs.unknowns: Carriageway, design vehicle, curve/junction/turning/entrance-widening requirements; protection authority; survey and drainage; product variation/area/saleable limits; prices, rates and market evidence. Internal8 m corridor provisional.

heldResult.message: No improvement found among the supported trials with entrance and spaces held. Review rejected trials for the binding constraints. This does not prove no better layout exists.
